title: RulesetManifest
description: Schema for a ruleset manifest file (e.g. manifest.json), declaring ruleset identity, metadata, available entity types, rendering/editing templates, and static assets.

id.description: Ruleset identifier: either a unique UUID or a short slug ID (e.g. 'open5e', 'dnd5e', 'pathfinder2e').

uuid.description: Optional unique UUID identifier for the ruleset when 'id' is a human-readable slug.

name.description: Human-readable display title of the ruleset (e.g. 'Open5e SRD Ruleset').

version.description: Semantic version of the ruleset package (e.g. '1.0.0').

description.description: A summary or full description of the ruleset.

author.description: Primary author or organization responsible for this ruleset.

license.description: License under which this ruleset is published (e.g. 'OGL 1.0a', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'MIT').

homepage.description: URL to the project homepage or documentation.

entities.description: Available entity types defined by this ruleset. May be an array of entity descriptors or a dictionary mapping entity type IDs to descriptors.

templates.description: Templates available for rendering, editing, and displaying entities in this ruleset.

assets.description: Static assets (images, icons, fonts) associated with this ruleset and its templates.

path.description: Base relative directory containing static assets (e.g. 'assets' or 'images').

images.description: List of image files or patterns used by templates.

fonts.description: List of font files used by templates.

dependencies.description: Dependencies on other rulesets (e.g. base ruleset for an expansion).

entityDescriptor.description: Declaration of an entity type within the ruleset.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entity type (e.g. 'character', 'monster', 'spell', 'item').

name.description: Human-readable name of the entity type (e.g. 'Player Character').

description.description: Description of what this entity type represents.

schema.description: Relative path to the JSON schema file that defines this entity type's properties (e.g. 'entities/character.json').

default_template.description: Identifier of the default template (mode 'sheet'/'view'/'card'/'print') used to display this entity type.

templates.description: List of template IDs associated with this entity type.

default_editor.description: Identifier of the default template (mode 'edit') used to author/edit this entity type.

allowed_editors.description: Template IDs (mode 'edit') that are compatible with this entity type.

icon.description: Relative path to an icon image or an icon identifier.

color.description: Theme color associated with this entity type.

templateDescriptor.description: Declaration of a template used for rendering and editing entities.

name.description: Display name of the template (e.g. 'Standard Character Sheet').

description.description: Description of the template and its intended use.

entity_types.description: Entity types supported by this template.

mode.description: Target mode of the template. 'sheet'/'view'/'card'/'print' are read-only display templates. 'edit' is a full entity editor form. 'widget' is a reusable field-level editor partial (referenced by 'ui.widget' in entity definitions and by other templates via {{> widgetId}}) rather than a directly requestable page.

html.description: Relative path to the HTML template file (e.g. 'templates/character_sheet.html').

css.description: Relative path(s) to CSS stylesheets for this template.

js.description: Relative path(s) to JavaScript scripts for this template.

config.description: Template-specific configuration data or path to a JSON configuration file.
